title: Entfernungspauschale (commuting allowance) from 2026
summary: For each working day on which the employee goes to the first place of work (erste Tätigkeitsstätte), 0.38 EUR per full kilometre of the one-way distance between home and workplace, from the first kilometre, up to 4,500 EUR per calendar year. A higher amount applies only if an own or provided car is used. Not for flights or tax-free collective transport.

calc.cap_waived_if: own or provided car is used

conditions: Only the one-way distance counts, in full kilometres
Counts per working day on which the first place of work is visited
Does not apply to flight routes or routes with tax-free collective transport (§ 3 Nr. 32 EStG)

sources.label: BMF Lohnsteuer-Handbuch 2026, Anhang 14 (cited by search results; page not retrievable)

notes: 0.38 EUR from the first km applies from 1 January 2026 (Art. 2 and Art. 12 Abs. 2 of the amending law). Political proposals to change the rate again are not law and are not encoded here.
